name: Yentl Collin
intro: I work on generative models at the Institute of Foundation Models (IFM) at MBZUAI, with the Speech / LLM team. My interests lie in flow matching, discrete diffusion, and efficient generation for speech and language. I am also interested in recurrent and subquadratic sequence models, including SSMs, xLSTMs, linear attention, and hybrid architectures.

I hold a master’s degree in Mathematics, Vision and Learning (MVA) from ENS Paris-Saclay and an engineering degree from École des Ponts et Chaussées (ENPC). Previously, I worked on recurrent models and state-space models (SSMs) for interpretable time-series learning in Chirag J. Patel’s lab at Harvard University.

interests.title: Generative modeling
interests.text: Flow matching, flow-map distillation, and discrete diffusion for speech, language, and images.

interests.title: Efficient foundation models
interests.text: Few-step inference, inference-time scaling, and distillation from Transformers to state-space models.

interests.title: Time series & tabular
interests.text: Interpretable learning for time-series and tabular data, state-space models, and forecasting.
